en: This again... Was that another one of{SAUT}Hikari's memories?
It certainly fits the pattern.{PAGE}The Hikari-san in that clip was the{SAUT}same one from the musical again.
But those aren't the same as the musicals{SAUT}though... they're more of an ordinary{SAUT}slice-of-life kinda thing.
They feel like my memories...{SAUT}Really precious ones...{PAGE}But, I can't remember...
Why though? They're my own{SAUT}memories... I want to remember{SAUT}them, but...
It's almost like... I'm refusing{SAUT}to remember, deep down...
Thanks... I promise I'll get there...
Right―you've got us by your side too.{SAUT}Let's go.
